scope: Static semantic, merge-scope and dependency/license-change review of pinned en-de/Harper heads; no GitHub Actions and no post-cutoff refresh.
disposition: No semantic or license-change blocker found; normalize Dart formatting and run source-bound focused gates after integration.
observations: Only U+00AD is removed from Harper input; source text, other punctuation, controls and line breaks remain literal.

Per-scalar source start/end tables map backend Unicode-scalar findings to original UTF-16. Nonempty ranges include internal omitted controls and exclude adjacent controls. Insertions select the next visible scalar or source end.
Range validation throws on negative, reversed or out-of-bounds backend ranges. Grapheme boundaries are checked in projected and original text; partial-grapheme findings are omitted individually.
Original source remains limited to 32768 Unicode scalars before projection, and responses remain limited to 2000 findings. Range lookup after construction is constant time.

Host-owned OfficeProofingVocabulary is shared by the example controller with Harper. Existing language canonicalization, case-sensitive membership and per-language storage remain; only spelling findings are suppressed, while grammar/style findings remain.
Vocabulary revision participates in provider configurationRevision and is captured across asynchronous transport checks. A changed revision returns an explicit failed result requiring a fresh check.
Added en-CA/en-AU/en-IN picker choices correspond to dialects already supported by HarperProofingProvider.
The 65d581 subset is included by bdd752. Later changes add native/Web projection acceptance assertions and validation-hook coverage; they do not alter native/Wasm implementation.
ODS worksheet source and historical evidence in these histories are carryover, already reviewed separately. Root reported all four pinned tips and main merged cleanly at local HEAD765438f6.

dependency_license_delta.conclusion: No new dependency, native source, font, dictionary or licensed data is introduced by the Harper/en-de delta. Existing broader license audit remains necessary and retains its original scope; this review is a change audit.
dependency_license_delta.new_assets: Dart adapter/source-mapping code, tests, Python/JavaScript validation tools and documentation only.

focused_validation.format_observation: New remote-authored harper_source_contract_test.dart contains unformatted long calls; normalize using pinned Dart and include source/test/tool format gate.
focused_validation.real_backend_limitation: Fresh Dart contracts use injected transport and do not establish actual Harper native/Wasm backend acceptance. No Harper .so or .wasm is installed under the restored toolchain. Preserve historical backend receipts with original attribution; do not claim them as freshly rerun.
focused_validation.semantic_reference: tool/source_projection_probe.mjs and its historical 28-check JSON are an independent JavaScript reference, not compiled Dart or native/Wasm acceptance.

non_blocking_limits: Vocabulary normalization is the pre-existing finite Latin/accent/hyphen canonicalization, not full Unicode NFC or locale-aware case folding.
The new dialog dialect labels have general dialog/session coverage, but the existing tests do not explicitly tap every newly added dialect label.
This is a focused static review and recommended local qualification, not a new full native/Wasm build or whole-repository license audit.
